storyCards.headline: You Can't Always Get What You Want: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Rolling Stones's "You Can't Always Get What You Want" reached #42 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #42 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 8 weeks on the chart.

You Can't Always Get What You Want was released in 2004.

Chart story — peaked at #42 on the Hot 100.
